nodes.name: metadata_enricher.py
nodes.summary: Metadata enricher: extracts document metadata (title, author, dates, document codes like 214.HD-ACT-HC) from PDF/DOCX using regex patterns and LLM fallback. Enriches chunks with structured metadata for improved retrieval filtering and citation display.

nodes.name: models/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Models package init: exports Pydantic models for API requests/responses (ChatQuery, ChatResponse, Citation, Document, SearchResult), database entities (User, Conversation, Message), and configuration settings (Settings, ModelConfig).

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Database schema models: SQLAlchemy models for User, Conversation, Message, Document, Chunk, Embedding, and metadata tables. Defines relationships, indexes, and constraints. Used with async SQLAlchemy 2.0 and asyncpg.

nodes.name: parsers/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Parsers package init: exports document parsing functions (parse_pdf, parse_docx, parse_txt), chunking strategies (semantic, fixed-size, recursive), and OCR pipeline (tesseract, layout analysis). Registry pattern for extensibility.

nodes.name: pdf_parser.py
nodes.summary: PDF parser: uses pdfplumber for text extraction, Tesseract OCR for scanned pages (tuned: vie, psm 6, oem 1, dpi 400), layout detection (tables, headers), and metadata extraction. Handles Vietnamese diacritics preservation. Called by ingest pipeline.

nodes.name: docx_parser.py
nodes.summary: DOCX parser: uses python-docx for text, tables, images, and styles extraction. Preserves document structure (headings, lists, tables) for semantic chunking. Extracts document codes from headers/footers.

nodes.name: executor.py
nodes.summary: SQL executor: core Text2SQL pipeline with get_llm_complete() implementing 6-key Gemini API rotation (round-robin on 429, shared RPM limit, per-key daily quota persistence to quota_state.json, project-level 60s cooldown, max 18 attempts). Executes generated SQL with guard validation (uid filter, readonly role).

nodes.name: router.py
nodes.summary: LLM Router: classifies queries into routes (DB_ONLY, DOC_ONLY, HYBRID, DIRECTORY, OUT_OF_SCOPE) using Gemma-4-31B with rewrite_and_route_step prompt. Keyword fallback for new domains. Route guards in chat_service.py. Prompt rules for rewrite (keep doc names, handle pronouns).

nodes.name: schema_registry.py
nodes.summary: Schema registry: dynamic database schema introspection (tables, columns, FKs, indexes) cached in Redis. Provides table descriptions, column types, and relationship hints for Text2SQL prompt construction. Syncs with PostgreSQL information_schema on startup.

nodes.name: text2sql.py
nodes.summary: Text2SQL generator: builds prompts with schema context, few-shot examples, and guard rules. Uses Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite for SQL generation. Post-processes: validates syntax, applies guard (uid filter), executes with timeout, and returns results with explanations.

nodes.name: gemini_key_manager.py
nodes.summary: Gemini API key manager: round-robin rotation across 6 keys (GEMINI_API_KEY_1..5 + GEMINI_API_KEY), per-key RPM/daily quota tracking, 429 handling with exponential backoff, quota_state.json persistence, and project-level cooldown. Shared RPM limit (15) enforced globally.
